bindingAllocation.rule: The request and callback form one purpose-separated handshake. SVC-PEP-APR-001 and SVC-PEP-HRM-001 remain employee-change-only and cannot be reused or widened.

v58NonRegression.rule: V59 creates HRM-013-specific tables and contracts. It does not alter a V58 column, constraint, trigger, row, purpose, proof namespace, request mapping, callback path or employee-change runtime.

newTables.name: apr_hrm013_tenant_grants
newTables.purpose: Append-only current grant revisions for the exact People-to-Approval waiver request and Approval-to-People decision callback pair.
checks: grant_revision > 0, tenant_grant_revision > 0 and authorization_revision > 0
decision IN ADMIT|REVOKE
request_binding_id = SVC-PEP-APR-002 and request_purpose_code = HRIS_SEPARATION_TASK_WAIVER_REQUEST
callback_binding_id = SVC-PEP-HRM-010 and callback_purpose_code = HRIS_SEPARATION_TASK_WAIVER_DECISION
grant_digest is lowercase hexadecimal length 64
newTables.immutability: Append-only revisions; update and delete are rejected. grant_revision is only the ledger row version. tenant_grant_revision and authorization_revision are separate immutable signed-proof fence values and cannot be derived from or substituted for grant_revision. Current authority is the highest same-tenant grant_revision and must be ADMIT.

newTables.name: apr_hrm013_proof_replays
newTables.purpose: Single-use replay namespace dedicated to the two HRM-013 bindings without widening V58 constraints.
checks: token_kind IN JTI|REQUEST_NONCE
token_digest is lowercase hexadecimal length 64 and is SHA-256 of one canonical UUID proof value
the raw jti and requestNonce are canonical UUIDs, differ before hashing, and their token_digest values differ
binding_id and caller_workload_id equal SVC-PEP-APR-002/dwp-people-server or SVC-PEP-HRM-010/dwp-approval-server
expires_at > reserved_at and expires_at <= reserved_at plus 35 seconds
newTables.reservationRule: After transport and proof validation, SHA-256 each distinct canonical-UUID jti and requestNonce and atomically insert two separate JTI and REQUEST_NONCE rows. tenant_id plus token_digest is the only replay identity, so reuse fails closed even when binding_id, caller_workload_id or token_kind changes; those three columns are audit metadata only.
newTables.persistenceRule: Persist only token_digest. Raw jti, raw requestNonce, JWT/JWS bytes, authorization values and certificate material are forbidden in this table.
newTables.retention: Retain through proof expiry plus five seconds, then bounded cleanup; collision always fails closed.
newTables.immutability: Rows are insert-only until bounded expiry cleanup; update is rejected.

newTables.name: apr_hrm013_waiver_request_bindings
newTables.purpose: Immutable request, target, maker, policy and exact wire evidence for one separation-task waiver approval.
checks: tenant_grant_revision, authorization_revision, requested_task_owner_revision and frozen_policy_revision are positive and requested_task_version is non-negative
required_step_up_audience = dwp-people-server
required_step_up_purpose = HRIS_SEPARATION_TASK_WAIVER_DECISION
approval_request_payload_sha256, request_body_sha256, command_digest and response_body_sha256 are lowercase hexadecimal length 64
octet_length(exact_request_body) is between 1 and 32768 and SHA-256(exact_request_body) equals request_body_sha256
octet_length(exact_response_body) is between 1 and 16384 and SHA-256(exact_response_body) equals response_body_sha256
newTables.multipleWaiverRule: Neither case nor task is unique by itself. Distinct approval_request_id and idempotency_key values permit independent waiver requests for multiple tasks and later policy-authorized attempts for one task without weakening exact replay.
newTables.privacy: The closed request contains only public IDs, reason code, positive revisions, digest and correlation. Worker names, identifiers, documents and unrestricted narrative are forbidden.
newTables.immutability: Every column is immutable; update and delete are rejected.

newTables.name: apr_hrm013_waiver_decision_outbox
newTables.purpose: Durable exact SeparationWaiverDecisionV2 delivery with bounded retry, fresh proof per attempt and exact safe receipt retention.
checks: decision IN APPROVED|REJECTED, decision_revision > 0, owner_revision > 0 and owner_revision = decision_revision
tenant_grant_revision > 0 and authorization_revision > 0
decision_actor_public_id differs from both case_maker_public_id and requested_by_actor_public_id
callback_path exactly equals the sealed case/task waiver-decisions path

APPROVED requires all seven step-up columns non-null, step_up_evidence_audience = dwp-people-server, step_up_evidence_purpose = HRIS_SEPARATION_TASK_WAIVER_DECISION, step_up_consumed_at >= step_up_verified_at and step_up_consumed_at <= decision_occurred_at
REJECTED requires all seven step-up columns null
step_up_evidence_nonce_sha256 and step_up_evidence_sha256 are lowercase hexadecimal length 64 when present
step_up_verified_at is within the frozen workflow freshness window at decision_occurred_at and one nonce digest is consumed only once
delivery_state IN PENDING|CLAIMED|RETRY|DELIVERED|DEAD|RESULT_UNKNOWN
attempt_count is between 0 and the sealed bounded retry maximum
CLAIMED requires a complete lease and every other state forbids a live lease
approval_request_payload_sha256, callback_payload_sha256, callback_body_sha256, command_digest and present receipt_body_sha256 are lowercase hexadecimal length 64
octet_length(exact_callback_body) is between 1 and 32768 and SHA-256(exact_callback_body) equals callback_body_sha256
DELIVERED requires exact receipt bytes of 1 through 16384 octets, matching receipt digest and delivered_at; non-DELIVERED forbids them
newTables.lineageRule: approval_request_payload_sha256 is copied from the immutable APR-002 request binding and emitted as originatingPayloadSha256. callback_payload_sha256 is the HRM-010 body payloadSha256. These two values, callback_body_sha256 and command_digest are separate and may never alias by convention.
newTables.stableFields: Every grant identity and its separate tenant/authorization revisions, request identity, decision, owner revision, maker, requester, actor, reason, conditional step-up evidence, callback path, correlation, originating request digest, callback-self digest, exact callback body and command digest is immutable. Only the bounded delivery lease, attempt, failure and terminal receipt fields may advance through legal CAS transitions.

grantRevisionContract.ledgerRevision: apr_hrm013_tenant_grants.grant_revision is the append-only per-tenant ledger row version only; it is never emitted as tenantGrantRevision or authorizationRevision.

inboundApr002Claims.tenantGrantRevision: exactly apr_hrm013_tenant_grants.tenant_grant_revision from the one current highest-grant_revision ADMIT row
inboundApr002Claims.authorizationRevision: exactly apr_hrm013_tenant_grants.authorization_revision from that same current ADMIT row

outboundHrm010Claims.tenantGrantRevision: exactly apr_hrm013_waiver_decision_outbox.tenant_grant_revision copied from its immutable request binding and same grant_id current ADMIT row
outboundHrm010Claims.authorizationRevision: exactly apr_hrm013_waiver_decision_outbox.authorization_revision copied from its immutable request binding and same grant_id current ADMIT row

grantRevisionContract.admissionRule: APR-002 selects exactly one highest grant_revision row for tenant_id and requires decision ADMIT, request binding/purpose, People SPIFFE/signing key and both signed tenantGrantRevision and authorizationRevision to equal that row. It atomically copies grant_id plus both revision values into the immutable request binding; mixing values from different grant rows is forbidden.
grantRevisionContract.outboxRule: The HRM-010 outbox copies the same grant_id, tenant_grant_revision and authorization_revision from the immutable APR-002 request binding. Outbox creation and each send attempt re-read that exact grant_id and require it is still the current highest-grant_revision ADMIT row with the same callback binding/purpose, Approval SPIFFE/signing key and both revision values; otherwise dispatch fails closed and no proof is minted.
grantRevisionContract.proofRule: Each HRM-010 proof emits tenantGrantRevision and authorizationRevision from that one revalidated current row and emits ownerRevision from the outbox. No proof may combine a ledger row version, tenant grant revision, authorization revision or signing identity from different rows.

requestAndDecisionRules: Approval revalidates the one current highest-grant_revision ADMIT HRM-013 tenant grant, exact People workload identity, signed tenantGrantRevision and authorizationRevision from that same row, binding, audience, purpose, path and body digest before native request creation.

The Approval request binds exactly one case, one task, one task type, one requested task-owner revision, one requested task version, the People maker and the requesting actor. Caller-supplied workflow, form, approver, quorum or step-up satisfaction is forbidden.
Approval resolves and freezes a published effective typed workflow and form, independent approver/quorum policy and required dwp-people-server step-up audience.

Only a terminal native APPROVED or REJECTED decision creates one outbox row. The terminal accepted vote actor is the callback decision actor and cannot equal either the immutable People maker or requester.

APPROVED consumes exactly one fresh step-up evidence identity and nonce with the sealed People audience and HRM-010 purpose; its audience, purpose, nonce digest, evidence digest, verified time and consumed time are copied into the exact callback. REJECTED carries none of those fields.

The callback body, callback-self payload digest and APR-002 originating payload digest are stable and distinct across retries. Each delivery attempt revalidates the same grant_id is the current ADMIT row, emits its exact tenantGrantRevision and authorizationRevision plus ownerRevision equal to decisionRevision, and uses a fresh workload proof while exact callback bytes and command digest remain unchanged.
408, 425, 429, transport failure and 5xx are bounded retry classes. Other 4xx are permanent. Retry exhaustion becomes RESULT_UNKNOWN or DEAD according to whether remote commit is ambiguous.
An exact People receipt of at most 16384 bytes completes delivery; a malformed, oversized, mismatched or digest-invalid receipt is never treated as success.

wireToStorageMapping.SHA-256 of stepUpEvidenceNonce: step_up_evidence_nonce_sha256; the raw nonce exists only inside immutable exact_callback_body

stepUpEvidenceContract.digestEncoding: Encode the eight values in order as canonical UTF-8 with one LF delimiter and no trailing LF, then SHA-256 lowercase hexadecimal.
stepUpEvidenceContract.approvedRule: Approval validates issuer, actor, audience, purpose and frozen freshness, atomically consumes the tenant-scoped evidence identity and nonce digest, and persists all seven values with the exact callback body in the terminal decision transaction.
stepUpEvidenceContract.rejectedRule: REJECTED omits every step-up field from body and proof and stores every step-up column null; explicit null wire values are invalid.

requiredFutureVerificationAfterActiveLea: V59 clean install and V58-to-V59 upgrade without any V58 object definition or behavior change.
Wrong tenant, caller, SPIFFE, signing key, binding, audience, purpose, path, digest, grant revision, jti or nonce fails before request or outbox reads.
Same request idempotency and bytes return the original exact response while changed bytes return conflict without another Approval request.

Maker-checker compares decision actor with both immutable maker and requester; published typed workflow/form and uniquely consumed audience/purpose-bound step-up evidence are mandatory only for APPROVED.
APPROVED and REJECTED each produce one immutable typed outbox event with exact retry bytes, separate APR-002 origin and HRM-010 self payload digests, and no personal payload.
Crash before send, after remote commit and before local receipt persistence recovers without duplicate Approval decision or People waiver mutation.
Cross-tenant RLS, terminal delivery immutability and bounded retry/lease fencing pass.
invalidationConditions: SVC-PEP-APR-001, SVC-PEP-HRM-001 or any V58 employee-change table, constraint, trigger, purpose or runtime is widened for HRM-013.
The People maker selects the Approval workflow, form, approver, quorum or step-up result.
A callback decision actor equals the maker or an APPROVED decision lacks fresh owner-verified step-up evidence.
A callback decision actor equals the immutable requester, step-up evidence or nonce is reused, its audience or purpose differs, or REJECTED carries any step-up field.
The outbox aliases APR-002 approval_request_payload_sha256 with HRM-010 callback_payload_sha256 or fails to preserve either digest in exact callback bytes.
Retry changes callback bytes or command digest, reuses jti or requestNonce, or treats an invalid receipt as delivered.
Any HRM-013 table lacks enabled and forced tenant RLS.
V59 SQL or source is authored before a separate Approval lease and hash-bound executable token.
